findings.message: At the start the purple Next step arrow and the dark grey Full-batch step arrow almost completely overlap, so the batch noise this SGD scene is meant to show is hard to see in the opening view.

These captures never sampled the batch-size options, the low learning-rate end (0.01) or the New run / kept-path comparison, so this review does not confirm that the noise changes with batch size or that the ghost path appears.

The run says 'converged' and stops while the ball is plainly still on the slope below the Lowest point dot. The loss is 0.061 and z is about 0.5, so it is still sliding toward the bottom. The settle band (slope along z under 0.35, which allows z up to 0.7) is much wider than the noise jitter, which is about 0.14×0.25 ≈ 0.035 per step.
